get.description:
Download one artifact (any authenticated role; no-store).

The id resolves only to a path inside the canonical artifact root
(:func:`ccat.db.artifacts.resolve_download`); sensitive kinds are
recorded in the security-audit events (§8).

Args:
    artifact_id: The artifact id.
    request: The current request.
    inline: Display PDF artifacts inline instead of downloading.
    _user: Authenticated identity.
    _csrf: CSRF guard.

Returns:
    The file response.

Raises:
    ApiError: 404 unknown artifact/missing file; 403 path escape.

post.description:
Log in via the dev no-password adapter (204 + session cookie).

No CSRF guard: there is no session yet (the rate limiter protects
the endpoint); the session cookie issued here is authenticated on
later mutations via :func:`require_csrf`.

Args:
    body: The username.
    request: The current request.
    response: The response receiving the cookie.

Returns:
    An empty 204 response.

Raises:
    ApiError: 403 when auth mode is not ``dev`` (with guidance);
        401 for unknown/inactive/non-dev users; 429 over the rate
        limit.

Revoke the session and clear the cookie (204).

Args:
    request: The current request.
    response: The response clearing the cookie.
    user: The authenticated identity.
    _csrf: CSRF guard.

Returns:
    An empty 204 response.

get.description:
Return the authenticated identity and CSRF token.

Args:
    user: The authenticated identity.

Returns:
    The identity view (the CSRF token is same-origin-readable by
    design; the session cookie itself is HttpOnly).

Return the configuration tree the settings UI edits.

The tree is the file's own values over the model's defaults, so
every known setting appears — including the ones the file leaves
implicit — and any setting added to the file later appears without
a frontend change.

Args:
    request: The current request.

Returns:
    ``{"path": ..., "config": {...}}`` with the merged tree.

schema.title: Response Get Config Api V1 Config Get

put.description:

    _admin: Admin guard.
    _csrf: CSRF guard.

Returns:

Raises:
